dataList.content:
Still in a battlefield...
又是，战场之中……
dataList.place:
Central Front in the Smoke War
烟霾战争 中部战线

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
... It’s the same place as before. Something's changed, though.
……是和之前一样的场所。虽然有了点变化。

Someone came up from behind and suddenly tugged at Heathcliff's shirt.
有谁急切地扯了扯希斯克利夫的外套。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
Are you out of your minds? Get to shelter, now! You’ll age rapidly if exposed to that bomb’s blast.
你们疯了吗？快点去避难啊！被那种炸弹爆炸波及到的话，会急剧衰老。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
The Nest next to ours turned into a nursing home—they can’t even walk without sticks!
隔壁巢的员工们别说是打仗了，他们现在没有拐杖都走不了路！

Hold on, isn’t he the same guy we just...
等等，这个人不是刚刚那个……

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
But don't you worry, because Manager Gregor is with us!
不过没什么好担心的，毕竟格里高尔先生在这里！

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
He doesn’t suffer side effects like the rest of us do, and he can regenerate, too!
不像我们，不仅没有什么副作用，甚至还可以再生，不是吗？

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
He was operated on by none other than Hermann, our most skilled director.
毕竟是由论实力比任何人都卓越的赫尔曼董事亲自主刀的人。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
A hero like you shouldn’t be on the rearguard. I’ll give you a ride!
您这样的英雄可不该留在后方。我来送您一程吧！

Wh-what the hell? Get away from me!
搞、搞什么啊？不要靠近我！

Four pairs of wings emerged from his back, clicking and twitching.
伴随着嘎吱嘎吱的声音，四对翅膀从他的后背中钻了出来。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
Why are you running? You should be taking the lead on the front lines with our G Corp. banner held high!
为什么要逃跑？您应该高举G公司的旗帜，冲在战斗的最前线！

I never wanted any of this... Not the procedure, nor the war...
从来没有期待过这些事……无论是改造，还是战争……

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
Take the lead... Take... T...
带领我们……带领……带……

Tomah’s mouth tears open, and a pair of long antennae begin to break through his skin.
托玛的嘴部以一种古怪的方式裂开了，他的头上开始长出一对长长的触角。

Yikes... We gotta fight them again? My stomach is gonna turn...
噫……又要开打了吗？我的胃里要开始翻江倒海了……

What is that display of weakness? Do you wish to be punished for insubordination?
你在胡说什么？你想成为抗命者吗？

<... I think we should run here?>
<……还是逃命比较好吧？>

An excellent plan, Executive Manager. Knowing when to strike and when to withdraw is an excellent quality of a commander.
杰出的计划，经理。您很清楚什么时候该暂避锋芒。

... The hell is her deal?
……她到底有什么问题？

... Retreat is not an option.
……后退应该是不被允许的。

I don’t get it. I heard every employee under the corporation had modifications, but it couldn’t have been this foul.
我不理解。虽然听说是对所有员工都进行过改造，但应该还没有这么过分吧。

What we see here may differ from actual accounts.
可能与事实多少有些出入。

This path was not paved by Gregor's "memories," but his "heart."
因为，这条道路是由格里高尔先生的“心”而非“记忆”塑造而成的。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
... This is how he felt in his heart about his own allies.
……在他的心中，战友们所留下的印象就是这样的。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
Did all the employees in your Wing... receive the augmentation procedure?
那个巢中的所有员工……都接受了改造手术吗？

... Most did.
……大部分是。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
Was it done with their consent? That’s so...
他们都是在同意之下进行执刀的吗？这可真是……

Did the people in L Corp. consent to offering themselves up to Abnormalities?
L公司的员工，难道都是心甘情愿去献祭人类的吗？

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
That’s... I heard that was written in the contract.
那个……那个，据说是有明示在合同上的。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
We were never properly informed, though... They said such red tapes should be skipped for efficient management...
虽然我们并不知情……但是据说为了高效的管理，应当排除那些手续……

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
That we should face the fear.
只是说，应当直面恐惧。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
Meaning... everyone who joined the corporation agreed to it, knowingly or not.
所以说……加入公司的员工们全都是在不知情的状态下同意的。

... Can guess how it went for us, then.
……我们又有什么不同呢。
